purpose: Teach: リサイタル/霊感/傍観/重き/ダブリン/打席/スタメン/チューニング

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、バイオリンの、絶対、リサイタル、絶対、聴きに行くわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm absolutely going to come hear your violin recital. I mean it.
lines.style: Warm, reassuring promise delivered with gentle conviction. Soft attack on the opening word. Lean into the commitment — not performative, just sincere. Slow enough that he knows she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、霊感、絶対、あるかもしれない
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think I might actually have some kind of psychic sense about these things.
lines.style: Quiet, serious delivery of something he's genuinely thinking about. No cuteness — this is a real observation from his perspective. Slight pause before 'psychic sense' like he's picking the right word. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、傍観、絶対、せず、絶対、行動するように、絶対、心掛けているわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I try really hard not to just watch from the sidelines. I want to actually do something.
lines.style: Earnest and direct, but not heavy-handed. She's confessing something about how she tries to live. Steady pace. The word 'actually' carries a small weight — it matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、家族に、絶対、重き、絶対、を、絶対、置いてるよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, you really do put family first, don't you?
lines.style: Small voice of recognition. He's noticing something true about her and naming it gently. Not a question seeking confirmation — more like thinking out loud in her presence. Warm observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ダブリン、絶対、の、絶対、お話、絶対、本で、絶対、読みたいわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'd really love to read some stories about Dublin. From a book.
lines.style: Wistful, thoughtful shift. She's speaking about something she wants for herself now. Slower pace. The phrase 'from a book' is soft and specific — she's imagining it. A small dream stated quietly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、野球の、絶対、打席、絶対、立ってたんだって
lines.en: Mei-sis, your dad actually stood at bat in a baseball game, didn't he?
lines.style: Animated, slightly amazed tone. He's sharing something he just learned and wants her to know. Bright attack. The wonder of a kid who's discovered an unexpected fact about someone he knows. Energy without loudness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お友達のチームで、絶対、スタメン、絶対、になれたんだって?本気で
lines.en: Sho, so you made the starting lineup on your friend's team? That's incredible!
lines.style: Warm praise with genuine delight. Slight lean forward in the voice. The exclamation feels earned, not performed. She's happy for him and showing it clearly, but not overdoing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのギターの、絶対、チューニング、絶対、ちゃんと、絶対、出来たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually got my guitar tuning right all by myself.
lines.style: Quiet pride in a small accomplishment. Gentle but clear. The emphasis lands on 'all by myself' — it matters that he did this. A moment of satisfaction, not boastful. Ending with a small sense of completion.
